exposure: participation of professionals in simulation-based training
cohort: The participants were 339 healthcare professionals (147 nurses and 192 doctors) from 27 hospitals involved in the Appropriate Delivery Project in Brazil.
finding: Simulation-based training for healthcare professionals was associated with a significant increase in the rate of vaginal births in participating hospitals.
mod_finding: The percentage of vaginal births increased from 27.8% to 36.1% during the pilot test and further to 39.8% in the post-intervention period, particularly when the participation rate of nurses exceeded the median.
